maddeler.e: طُحْلُب or طِحْلَب or طِحْلِب or طَحْلُب • (ṭuḥlub or ṭiḥlab or ṭiḥlib or ṭaḥlub) f (plural طَحَالِب (ṭaḥālib))
maddeler.t: From the root ط ح ل ب (ṭ ḥ l b) meaning "to be overspread with green", related to ط ح ل (ṭ ḥ l) meaning "to be dingy or dusky", "to be greenish-grey", "to be turbid or murky".
s: ط ح ل ب (ṭ ḥ l b)
